name: Risorgimento Resort
insider_take: This elegant palazzo sits in the heart of Lecce's baroque wonderland, where every corner tells a story of southern Italian splendor.
whats_special: The Risorgimento Resort occupies a meticulously restored 19th-century noble palace just steps from Lecce's stunning Basilica di Santa Croce. You're staying in the "Florence of the South," where the golden Lecce stone glows at sunset and baroque architecture reaches artistic heights found nowhere else in Italy.
pro_tip: Visit the nearby Roman Amphitheatre at golden hour - it's partially hidden beneath Piazza Sant'Oronzo and offers incredible photo opportunities without the crowds of Rome's Colosseum.
dont_miss: The legendary pasticciotto leccese (custard-filled pastry) at Alvino pasticceria, just a 3-minute walk away. This local delicacy was invented right here in Lecce and nowhere else does it quite right. Also explore the underground Cripta di Sant'Antonio - a hidden 12th-century church discovered beneath the city streets.
pros: Historic palazzo setting in baroque Lecce with preserved architectural details
Prime location in Lecce's historic center within walking distance of major attractions
Elegant rooms blending traditional Italian design with modern luxury amenities
Exceptional rooftop terrace with panoramic views of Lecce's historic skyline
cons: Historic building may have limited modern conveniences in some areas
Central location means potential for street noise during busy periods
